content: Indication-specific dosing for Baxyl and Runovia (containing hyaluronan and herbal components) is as follows: Administer 5 mL orally twice daily (PO BID). This regimen is intended to promote healthy joint mobility and lubrication, as well as to enhance the maintenance of cartilage and joint tissues. No conclusive results are available regarding certain outcomes. Hypersensitivity reactions may occur, particularly in individuals sensitive to gram-positive bacterial proteins. The safety and efficacy of this treatment have not been established for use in children. Regarding pregnancy and lactation, no specific category is assigned (Pregnancy Category: N/A, Lactation: N/A). However, it is generally considered acceptable (Category A), as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
